description: Benchmark thresholds (prompt 123): per component and scenario, the metric, comparator (le, ge, eq, within), the pass threshold and the warn threshold; outside the warn threshold is a failure and a metric that cannot be measured is a warning. The operator setting benchmark.thresholds (same shape) is merged over this file: its suite values replace these, and a component it lists replaces that component's checks. 'gating' names the components each autonomous feature depends on and the component behind each finding type.

change-point.note: confirmed change points per bucket on null data over the configured two-sided rate 2/targetArl
planted shifts of 2 and 3 SD found in the right direction
median hours from the planted change to the alarm
a two-day burst is not a change point
no confirmed downward change during an outage or low detectability
decisions never use a value published after the decision time
expected change points of a corpus case that the replay did not find
change points found where the case expects none (auto null cases)
the replay never used a value known after the step

anomaly.note: alerts per bucket on null data over the sensitivity's alpha
hours from the burst's start to the first alert

event-study.note: planted pre-event moves found as pre-event signals
the engine's placebo p of events without a move is consistent with no signal (about 0.5)

co-occurrence.note: false-discovery rate on null data at most q + 0.05

evidence.note: echoes add no independent group, confidence or evidence quality
events whose independent group count with echoes differs from the planted originators

canonical-linking.note: pairs linked into one canonical event that are one planted event
pairs of one planted event linked together

precursor.note: independent streams and series validated as precursors
shared-driver pairs validated without a co-movement flag
median lag within 12 h of the planted 48 h
the planted hit rate inside the hit-rate interval
decoy streams in the same batch validated
named precursors whose lifecycle disagrees with the case

situation-linker.note: pairs in one situation that are one planted storyline
pairs of one storyline in one situation

forecaster:base-rate.note: per populated bin, mean forecast within 0.05 of the observed frequency
Brier skill against pooled climatology after a rate change
calibration degrades gracefully after a rate change

forecaster:analog.note: Brier skill against the base-rate forecaster
Brier skill against the base-rate forecaster

forecaster:precursor.note: Brier skill against the consequent's base rate

per populated bin; checkpoint 124: the 120 probability is shrunk toward the base rate by n/(n + 20), so with about 20 discovery antecedents it sits about half-way between the base rate and the hit rate by design, and a deviation near 0.25 is that shrinkage (a warning), not a defect

forecaster:ensemble.note: Brier skill against the base-rate forecaster
Brier skill against the base-rate forecaster

social-physical.note: a planted narrative with no physical event under adequate coverage is unobserved (SOC-2)
the same narrative under thin coverage is insufficient-coverage, never unobserved (SOC-2)
a discussed physical event corroborates the claim; social evidence alone never does (SOC-1)
organic discussion at the usual level is not an attention gap
silence after a significant event under adequate coverage is an attention gap
a claim whose image was first seen earlier or elsewhere is contradicted
a cue-found claim matching only its own trigger always carries CUE_TRIGGER_MATCH (SOC-3)
